## Summary

Follow-through on the Sept 2 decision to place below-L7 work in the Primitives and Protocol Observability focus group.

- working-documents/kernel-enforced-runtime-proposal.md: the layer map across T&O, Identity & Trust, and Security & Privacy, and why the T&O part belongs in Primitives and Protocol. Only the T&O pieces are in this PR; the other two groups receive separate mappings in their own repos, all citing one evidence model.
- working-documents/cross-boundary-runtime-and-hitl-rows.md: filled rows for Agent → Gateway or Runtime and Agent → Human (HITL), plus observed Security and Provenance values for Agent → Tool. Vendor-neutral; any runtime in the SAF-M-74 class can satisfy them.
- tracing_landscape/05-ai-agent-observability/AAIF-REF-ARCH-NONO.md: reference architecture in the repo template, graded, as the checked source for the rows. Includes AAuth branch status relevant to #50.
- working-documents/fixtures/kernel-enforced-runtime/: the field reference the rows cite, a seven-record session whose hashes verify against nono's alpha scheme and golden vector, and the generator.

Finding stated in the documents: the nono realization does not propagate W3C trace context into the sandbox. A nono issue with the proposed default allow-list will be linked here.

## Related Issue

Updates #29. Related: #44 (approval relationship), #50 (delegation fields as shipped values).

## Review Notes

Three questions in the rows document, section 6. The first, whether enforcement_layer (kernel | broker | proxy) is a column or a Provenance value, changes the matrix shape and gates the other two working groups' mappings.

Suggested review window: 1 week (living documents).

## Follow-ups

- nono issue for TRACEPARENT / TRACESTATE / BAGGAGE allow-list and trace_id on audit records
- USE-CASES.md current-state text for E2, E3, E4 and a PRIOR-WORK.md summary row (separate PR)
- OTLP exporter as reference implementation, after nolabs-ai/nono#1704

Disclosure: drafted with AI assistance; all field names and claims checked against nolabs-ai/nono main (7450e43) and this repo at bd6c430.
